stories.title: WordPress Plugin Vulnerability Exposes 100,000 Sites to Complete Site Takeover Attacks
stories.description: A critical vulnerability in a widely used WordPress plugin has put more than 100,000 websites at risk of complete takeover attacks.

stories.title: Uber Fined Nearly $1 Billion by Dutch Regulators Over Automated Suspensions of Driver Accounts
stories.description: Dutch Data Protection Authority said it is imposing a fine of 825 million euros because Uber violated the EU’s General Data Protection Regulation.

stories.title: Microsoft Teams Phishing Deploys New SynkLoader Malware to Steal Windows Passwords
stories.description: Hackers pose as Teams IT staff to trick employees into installing SynkLoader, enabling stealthy malware attacks on corporate networks.

stories.title: 91 Vulnerabilities Patched in Spring Application Framework
stories.description: More than 200 vulnerabilities have been patched to date this year, compared to only 16 in 2025 and 22 in 2024.

stories.title: Shipping More AI Code Than You Can Secure? Watch How to Control Remediation Debt
stories.description: ActiveState surveys 300 security and engineering leaders on AI coding, open-source remediation debt, governance, and business risk.

stories.title: Critical Keycloak Password Reset Flaw Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Take Over Any Account
stories.description: Keycloak CVE-2026-18963 could let unauthenticated attackers skip the emailed action token and reset any user's password.

stories.title: Operation QUICSILVER Targets Myanmar Government and IT with QUICAgent Backdoor
stories.description: Operation QUICSILVER targets Myanmar government and IT sectors with graduation lures that deploy the Go-based QUICAgent backdoor.

stories.title: Microsoft August 2026 Windows Updates Trigger Issues on Devices Using RGB Lighting Features
stories.description: Microsoft is investigating Windows 11 issues where August 2026 updates cause games to freeze or crash on systems using RGB lighting drivers.

stories.title: The Outsized Shadow: Why 5% of AI Users Are Your Biggest Security Risk
stories.description: Akamai finds the top 5% of enterprise AI users interact at 12 times the rate of the bottom 50%, concentrating shadow AI risk.

stories.title: AmnesiaStealer Gives Hackers Hidden Control of Logged-In Browsers on Macs
stories.description: AmnesiaStealer targets Macs via fake GitHub pages, stealing passwords, browser sessions, crypto data, and sensitive files.

stories.title: Venezuelan Gets Record Federal Prison Term for ATM Jackpotting
stories.description: Juan Manuel Gouveia-Aguilera has been sentenced to 8 years in prison for his role in an ATM jackpotting scheme that caused millions in losses.

stories.title: Personal Information Exposed in Apollo Global Data Breach
stories.description: The private equity firm appears to have been targeted as part of a campaign focusing on major financial companies.
